NLU helps the system respond to user statements in a chat by learning from natural language examples and what the user says. Here you can turn on NLU for use in Virtual Agent and configure its settings.
VA Topic
Ask user if topic VA chose is correct

Asking this provides data that can help improve your NLU model and reduce incorrect topic predictions by your Virtual Agent, but consider how it will impact the chat flow. The fallback topic will be shown whenever topic prediction is noted as incorrect.

Asking this provides data that can help improve your NLU model and reduce incorrect topic predictions by your Virtual Agent when asked to switch topics, but consider how it will impact the chat flow. The original topic will resume whenever topic prediction is noted as incorrect.
